property.name: Mode
property.summary: Selects published download, staged follow, or stream follow behavior.

property.name: SourceSessionID
property.summary: Required source session identifier for staged-follow and stream-follow download modes.

property.name: BindLiveStreamItem
property.summary: Whether the opened or resumed stream-follow session should bind a live DataStreamItem to the buffered follow stream.

property.name: DownloadRequestSizeBytes
property.summary: Maximum payload bytes requested by the client per download request. Must be positive; defaults to 8 MiB. This controls client request chunking, not server upload policy or integrity segment boundaries. Larger values can increase per-request memory use.
